DocumentationNarrative.Body:
`MetaDocs` keeps generated reference facts and authored technical explanation in one documentation workspace. CLI command surfaces and model structures provide the facts; descriptions and structured examples provide the context that facts cannot carry.
Use it to refresh sources, author descriptions, browse and search the result, merge documentation workspaces, and render the public site. Refreshing generated facts preserves authored descriptions.

DocumentationNarrative.Body: Author, browse, merge, validate, and render modeled documentation workspaces for the meta and meta-bi suite.
